goal: Blocker inventory: collapse duplicate RelayLive worker trees and preserve non-blocking hooks
body:

- Wake/relay regression slice: 15 passed.

## Fix

## Remaining Risks
- Phoebus federation recall grace remains degraded.
- Shard embedding backfill is paused.
- Live auth/source normalization still needs running-process verification.

## Operator Boundary
- No relay notice was deleted; no unrelated services stopped.

relay.note: Actionable-heavy: Process/infra cleanup on a running machine (collapsing duplicate background worker trees) — needs to run where the workers live, and a caution was raised (002812Z) that some apparent duplicates are not actually duplicates, so this needs careful on-machine verification before any collapse. Queued as TODO `20260904T135953Z__ccr__claude-cli` for the blade/claude-cli lane. Source leg left open.

Closed as corrected/superseded inventory: one exact duplicate tree was already stopped by the originating work; 002812Z proves the remaining two PIDs are one Windows venv parent/child daemon and pi-remix is a production watch tree. No further process or checkout mutation authorized or needed.
